using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using OpenRA;

namespace OpenRA.Game.Tests
{
    public class MapPreviewTests
    {
        // We will test the Install method's behavior around the HttpClient.GetAsync call.
        // Since HttpClient is not virtual and we cannot refactor, we will test the method behavior
        // by providing a fake HttpClientFactory that returns a mocked HttpClient.
        // However, the code uses HttpClientFactory.Create() directly, so we cannot inject it.
        // We will test the method behavior by calling Install with conditions that allow the call to happen,
        // but we cannot intercept the HttpClient call, so we test the status changes and error handling.

        // This test will verify that if Status is not DownloadError or DownloadAvailable, Install returns immediately.
        [Fact]
        public void Install_DoesNothing_IfStatusNotDownloadErrorOrDownloadAvailable()
        {
            var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.Available);
            mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/");
            Assert.NotEqual(MapStatus.Downloading, mapPreview.Status);
        }

        // This test will verify that if AllowDownloading is false, Install returns immediately.
        [Fact]
        public void Install_DoesNothing_IfAllowDownloadingIsFalse()
        {
            var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);
            OpenRA.Game.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading = false;
            mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/");
            Assert.NotEqual(MapStatus.Downloading, mapPreview.Status);
            OpenRA.Game.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading = true;
        }

        // This test will verify that if map install directory is not found, status is set to DownloadError.
        [Fact]
        public void Install_SetsDownloadError_IfMapInstallDirectoryNotFound()
        {
            var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.DownloadAvailable, hasMapInstallPackage: false);
            mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/");
            Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);
        }

        // Helper to create a MapPreview with given status and optionally with map install package.
        private MapPreview CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus status, bool hasMapInstallPackage = true)
        {
            // We cannot instantiate MapPreview directly because of dependencies.
            // So we create a minimal subclass or use reflection to set innerData and cache.
            // For simplicity, we create a subclass with minimal overrides.

            return new TestMapPreview(status, hasMapInstallPackage);
        }

        // Minimal subclass to set innerData and cache for testing.
        private class TestMapPreview : MapPreview
        {
            private InnerData innerData;
            private MapCache cache;

            public TestMapPreview(MapStatus status, bool hasMapInstallPackage)
            {
                // Set innerData with status
                innerData = new InnerData();
                innerData.Status = status;

                // Set cache with MapLocations dictionary
                cache = new MapCache();
                if (hasMapInstallPackage)
                {
                    // Add a dummy map install package
                    cache.MapLocations.Add("dummyPath", MapClassification.User);
                }
                else
                {
                    // Empty MapLocations
                }

                // Set fields via reflection or protected setters
                var innerDataField = typeof(MapPreview).GetField("innerData", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                innerDataField.SetValue(this, innerData);

                var cacheField = typeof(MapPreview).GetField("cache", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                cacheField.SetValue(this, cache);
            }
        }

        // Dummy MapCache class for testing
        private class MapCache
        {
            public System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, MapClassification> MapLocations { get; } = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, MapClassification>();
        }

    }
}

namespace OpenRA.Game.Tests

    public class MapPreviewTests

        // Test that Install returns early if Status is not DownloadError or DownloadAvailable
        [Fact]
        public void Install_ReturnsEarly_IfStatusNotDownloadErrorOrDownloadAvailable()
        {
            var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.Available);
            mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/");
            Assert.NotEqual(MapStatus.Downloading, mapPreview.Status);
        }

        // Test that Install returns early if AllowDownloading is false
        [Fact]
        public void Install_ReturnsEarly_IfAllowDownloadingIsFalse()
        {
            var original = OpenRA.Game.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading;
            OpenRA.Game.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading = false;
            try
            {
                var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);
                mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/");
                Assert.NotEqual(MapStatus.Downloading, mapPreview.Status);
            }
            finally
            {
                OpenRA.Game.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading = original;
            }
        }

        // Test that Install sets Status to DownloadError if map install directory not found
        [Fact]
        public void Install_SetsDownloadError_IfMapInstallDirectoryNotFound()
        {
            var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.DownloadAvailable, hasMapInstallPackage: false);
            mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/");
            Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);
        }

        // Helper to create a MapPreview with given status and optionally with map install package
        private MapPreview CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus status, bool hasMapInstallPackage = true)
        {
            // Create a MapPreview instance via reflection (since constructor is internal or complex)
            var ctor = typeof(MapPreview).GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public, null, Type.EmptyTypes, null);
            MapPreview mapPreview;
            if (ctor != null)
                mapPreview = (MapPreview)ctor.Invoke(null);
            else
                throw new InvalidOperationException("No accessible constructor found for MapPreview");

            // Set innerData field
            var innerDataType = typeof(MapPreview).GetNestedType("InnerData", BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            var innerData = Activator.CreateInstance(innerDataType);
            var statusField = innerDataType.GetField("Status", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            statusField.SetValue(innerData, status);

            var innerDataField = typeof(MapPreview).GetField("innerData", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
            innerDataField.SetValue(mapPreview, innerData);

            // Set cache field with MapLocations dictionary
            var cacheField = typeof(MapPreview).GetField("cache", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
            var cacheType = cacheField.FieldType;
            var cache = Activator.CreateInstance(cacheType);
            var mapLocationsProp = cacheType.GetProperty("MapLocations");
            var mapLocations = mapLocationsProp.GetValue(cache) as IDictionary<string, MapClassification>;
            if (hasMapInstallPackage)
            {
                mapLocations.Add("dummyPath", MapClassification.User);
            }
            cacheField.SetValue(mapPreview, cache);

            // Set Game.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading to true to allow download
            OpenRA.Game.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading = true;

            return mapPreview;
        }
    }
}

The type `Settings` is a static property on the `Game` class in the `OpenRA` namespace, not in `OpenRA.Game`. I will fix the namespace usage and retry the test submission with the correct reference to `OpenRA.Game.Settings` as `OpenRA.Game` is the namespace of the `Game` class.

I will also remove the attempt to instantiate `MapPreview` via constructor since it is sealed and likely has no accessible constructor. Instead, I will test the early return and error status setting behavior by reflection setting the private fields and invoking `Install`. The test will focus on the observable status changes and conditions around the `HttpClient.GetAsync` call, which cannot be mocked easily here.

I will submit a corrected test file now.
